notes.title: Extra Levels Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings world!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193302/9ab993a9b0a233abe8e619290ef5735af0c65b7a.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193302/67ad88feec2a686e9e3840810fb7630426ee75d1.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33193302/61b966cb552771629732e8b5547205bcc8b5cc00.jpg[/img]

Over the past few months, I've been working away at some extra levels for War Ender. I am pleased to announce that those extra levels are available now! And the best part? They're free with the game. So now there's three more levels on top of the twenty four already within the base game! I hope you give them a look. Enjoy! :)
